description: One division problem grades your whole recomp: waist divided by height. Learn why 0.50 is the line your body composition is judged by, and the signal plan that pulls your ratio down while your weight barely moves.

scenes.narration: Tape measure again. | Waist at the navel. | Relaxed, morning. | Now your height. | Same units, centimeters. | Divide waist by height. | That ratio is yours. | It fits on one line. | It judges everything. | Write it down. | No rounding down. | At the end | I tell you | which side of the line | you are living on.

scenes.label: KEEP YOUR WAIST UNDER HALF YOUR HEIGHT
scenes.narration: Here is the line, the simplest rule in body composition: keep your waist under half your height. A ratio of zero point five zero. Above it, your waist is carrying more than your frame should, and on a light body that almost always means the skinny-fat pattern: storage outrunning muscle. Between zero point four six and zero point five zero, you are in the border zone, close enough that one good month flips you. At zero point four five and under, the recomp is winning, your waist answers to your frame again. Notice why this beats the scale. Your weight can stay identical while this ratio improves, muscle arriving as fat leaves, and the scale will call that nothing happening. The ratio calls it by its real name: victory.
scenes.sub: over 0.50: belly leads - under 0.45: recomp winning

beats.text: THIS IS YOUR REAL PROGRESS PHOTO

scenes.narration: Understand the machinery inside the ratio and you understand recomposition itself. The ratio falls in two ways: the waist shrinks, or the frame effectively grows as muscle fills your chest, back and legs and changes your proportions. A diet only pulls the first lever, and pulls it at the cost of the second, because dieting without training signals eats muscle too. Recomp pulls both levers at once: training signals tell the body to keep and build muscle, protein delivers the material, steps and sleep tilt fat handling toward burning. That is why two men can lose the same three kilos and look completely different. One lost fat and muscle and kept his ratio. The other lost fat, gained muscle, and his ratio dropped through the line. The waist-to-height number is the only cheap measurement that grades the trade correctly, which is why researchers use it to predict health risk better than BMI. For you it is simpler than research. It is the one number that cannot be fooled by water, glycogen, or a good pump. Measure monthly and it will grade your entire system without mercy. One more property of the ratio deserves respect: it predicts health outcomes better than weight or BMI in study after study, because it captures where tissue lives, not just how much of it exists. Central storage is the metabolically loud kind, the kind that talks back to your hormones. Your ratio is therefore not a vanity metric with good marketing. It is the cheapest health instrument you own, and it happens to grade your physique honestly at the same time.

Now the signal layer, because the ratio is really a report on your signaling. Every day your body receives a pile of calories and a set of instructions about where they belong. Training writes the instruction: muscle needs this. Protein underwrites it. Sleep and steps set the background chemistry that decides whether spare energy is burned quietly or parked centrally. When the instructions are loud, the ratio improves even at the same bodyweight, because tissue is being relocated, not just removed. When the instructions are silent, the default setting takes over, and the default for a sedentary adult body is central storage. That is the entire skinny-fat story told in one sentence: a light body running default settings. Your training, your protein spread, your steps and your nights are not four separate hobbies. They are one signal stack, and this ratio is its combined score. Improve any layer and the score moves. Improve all four and it moves like it means it.

beats.text: HEAVY GUYS NEED 10 CM. YOU NEED 2.

scenes.narration: Your advantage, in cold arithmetic. A heavy man at zero point five eight needs to lose eight or ten centimeters of waist to cross the line, a project measured in seasons. A skinny-fat man at zero point five two needs about two centimeters, a project measured in weeks. Your enemy looks big because it sits in the middle of a small frame, but in absolute terms it is a small pile of tissue with a short walk to the exit. That is why skinny-fat guys who finally run a real signal stack transform embarrassingly fast compared to everyone else in the gym. The distance was never the problem. The directions were. You now have the directions and the scoreboard. Two centimeters is a rounding error with a deadline.

beats.text: SAME TIME. SAME SPOT. SAME TAPE.

scenes.narration: One discipline before the plan, because this number is easy to ruin with bad measurement. Your waist moves a centimeter or two across a single day with food, water and posture, so daily measuring grades the weather, not the climate. Measure once a week at most, same morning conditions, same spot at the navel, tape flat and relaxed, and judge only the monthly trend. Take the photo the same way, front and side, same light. Between measurements, forget the tape exists and run the signal stack. Guys destroy their recomp by measuring daily, panicking at water, crash dieting for three days, and eating back the muscle they were building. The ratio rewards the patient and punishes the twitchy. Be the patient one. The number is monthly because the tissue is monthly, and pretending otherwise is how good systems get abandoned in week two.
Train with me. Three rounds. Forty-five seconds of plank, hard brace, ribs down, then thirty seconds of rest. The core you build here is the frame your waist gets judged against. Go.

beats.text: RUN THE STACK: TRAIN, PROTEIN, STEPS, SLEEP

scenes.narration: The plan is the stack, run together for thirty days. Three training sessions a week with progressive bodyweight work. Protein at one point six grams per kilo, spread across meals. Eight thousand steps as your floor. Seven to eight hours of sleep defended like a job. Calories at maintenance, because a crash diet shrinks the waist and the frame together and your ratio barely moves while your arms disappear. The mistakes that stall this number: dieting hard and calling the mirror change progress, when the ratio exposes it as relocation in the wrong direction. Measuring daily and obeying the noise. And training only the waist with endless crunches, which builds a muscle under the fat without changing the signal stack that put the fat there. The ratio does not care about your crunch count. It grades the whole system.

scenes.label: THEN WE DIVIDE AGAIN
scenes.narration: So, your ratio. Over zero point five five: the belly owns the frame right now, and the full stack is your program, no shortcuts around it. Between zero point five zero and zero point five five: you are in the border zone, and one honest month of the stack should cross you under the line. Under zero point five zero: the recomp is working, keep the stack and let muscle widen the gap. Under zero point four five: your frame is winning outright. Put your ratio in the comments, two decimals, just the number. In thirty days we divide again, and the trend will grade your recomp signaling better than any scale ever built.
scenes.sub: belly leads / border zone / recomp winning - trend decides

beats.text: PIN THE RATIO TO THE MIRROR

scenes.narration: Pin the ratio next to the mirror it is about to change. Thirty days from now we divide again, and two decimals will tell the truth about your whole system. If this helped, subscribe for the next test. This is {channel}. Train the cable.

title: Your Waist-to-Height Number Reveals the Truth About Your recomp signaling
